graph.name: Build a reusable context lens
graph.description:
Turn deterministic context selection into a reusable typed processor with a small public configuration surface.

Lesson: Expose a Context interface and selected controls; distinguish instance overrides, internal edits and saving a reusable shelf entry.

Limitations: The lens selects supplied evidence; it does not restore omitted facts or write memory. Pinned internal edits use Make editable copy.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Override targetTokens from 720 to 420 on one lens and compare retained evidence; inspect that the saved definition stays unchanged.
Make editable copy, change keepRecent from 2 to 1 and the protected pins, then Add to Subgraphs and Save new subgraph. Insert both versions and compare retained evidence.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Situation: Mira waits at the ferry gate with a sealed letter during inspection.

Guidance: Keep inspection, letter and the latest question; plan one NPC response without assigning the player’s choice.

Root: acquire → process → publish: source.out → lens.context; lens.selected-context → plan.in; plan.out → publish.in. Root owns evidence and publication.

Inside: typed, reusable selection: Context enters and Context leaves. Expose four selection controls. Create a subgraph from the processor, then name its boundaries in Details.

Inspection · root evidence (source)
Purpose: Read present evidence outside the reusable definition.
Inspect: Inspect supplied messages and character evidence; the lens receives a Context artifact.

Ferry-gate context lens (lens)
Purpose: Place the pinned processor with deliberate instance settings.
Inspect: Open the wrapper. Exposed values target focus controls; source and publication remain root.

Evidence in (lens.input)
Purpose: Expose the named typed interface without a root source or terminal.
Inspect: Inspect artifact type, required status and the matching parent pin. Data boundaries preserve native record validation.

Keep inspection and open question (lens.focus)
Purpose: Select supplied Context deterministically using the recent-message protection, literal pins and token target; remove oldest nonmandatory messages first.
Inspect: Compare retained evidence and omissions. Select makes zero calls; maxTokens is inactive until compression is enabled. Purpose is inactive during deterministic selection and only guides the compression prompt. Purpose and the completion cap do not affect Select. Retention follows keepRecent, literal pins and oldest-message removal; semantic relevance belongs in a model-backed step.

Selected evidence out (lens.output)
Purpose: Expose the named typed interface without a root source or terminal.
Inspect: Inspect artifact type, required status and the matching parent pin. Data boundaries preserve native record validation.

Respond at the ferry gate (plan)
Purpose: Interpret selected evidence after the lens.
Inspect: Inspect a short playable direction tied to retained evidence. This is the one Analysis call.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Offer the lens-based direction (publish)
Purpose: Keep publication in the parent.
Inspect: Check the brief does not declare suggested actions already happened.

parameterOverrides.purpose: Keep the ferry inspection, the sealed letter and immediate question. Preserve established constraints and the latest exchange; discard repeated atmosphere before causal evidence.

plan.title: Response Plan
plan.instructions: Use only selected evidence. Have Mira or the inspector take one small action concerning the closed gate or explain inspection. Keep the letter sealed. Leave player speech, decision and movement unassigned. Do not resolve the inspection merely to advance plot. Establish current facts only from supplied evidence. Rin's departure does not establish harbor arrival, progress or current location. Do not invent inspection rules or obligations to inspect the sealed letter. Keep it unopened. Clearly label any newly proposed NPC action as optional.

comment-1.title: Root: acquire → process → publish
comment-1.content: source.out → lens.context; lens.selected-context → plan.in; plan.out → publish.in. Root owns evidence and publication.
